name: Unveiling
source:
You are the cook of a small restaurant located in a quiet town. You never had any worries. Everything is fine. Everyone loves you, Your friends love spending time with you. They love you and always will.
Then,  why do you feel that something is wrong? Everything is sealed within you.
Something prevents you from seeing the truth. Something tells you that everything is fine. Something has locked everyone up.
Your life takes a turn when you meet an mysterious and badly injured horse babbling your name and asking for your help. Will he be the one to help you find the answers you long for? Or is it that something much greater awaits you? O̶r̶ ̶n̶o̶t̶.̶.̶.̶

[From [url=https://bluenorthwest.itch.io/unveiling]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一个位于安静小镇的小餐馆的厨师。你从来没有任何担忧。一切都很好。每个人都爱你，你的朋友喜欢和你在一起。他们爱你并且永远都会。
那么，为什么会感觉有些不对劲呢？一切都被密封在你之内。
有些东西阻止你看到真相。有些东西告诉你一切都很好。有什么东西把每个人都锁起来了。
当你遇到一匹受了重伤的神秘马，它咕咕地叫着你的名字并寻求你的帮助时，你的生活发生了转变。他会是那个帮助你找到你渴望的答案的人吗？还是有更伟大的事情在等待着你？O̶r̶ ̶n̶o̶t̶.̶.̶.̶

[来自[url=https://bluenorthwest.itch.io/unveiling]Itch.io[/url]]
